verdicts.title: Depth-Independent Lower bounds on the Communication Complexity of Read-Once Boolean Formulas
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We show lower bounds of $Ω(\sqrt{n})$ and $Ω(n^{1/4})$ on the randomized and quantum communication complexity, respectively, of all $n$-variable read-once Boolean formulas. Our results complement the recent lower bound of $Ω(n/8^d)$ by Leonardos and Saks and $Ω(n/2^{Ω(d\log d)})$ by Jayram, Kopparty and Raghavendra for randomized communication complexity of read-once Boolean formulas with depth $d$.
